name: Thrall
title: Former Warchief of the Horde
description: An orc shaman who freed his people from internment camps and united the Horde. A master of the elements, he later stepped down as Warchief but continued to defend Azeroth in its darkest hours.

name: Sylvanas Windrunner
title: The Banshee Queen
description: Once the Ranger-General of Silvermoon, she was slain by Arthas and raised as a banshee. She rose to lead the Forsaken and later the Horde, driven by a ruthless will to control her own fate.

name: Illidan Stormrage
title: The Betrayer
description: A powerful night elf who sacrificed everything for power to fight the Burning Legion. Feared and misunderstood, he leads the Illidari with the belief that any weapon may be used against the demons.

name: Arthas Menethil
title: The Lich King
description: The prince of Lordaeron who took up the cursed blade Frostmourne to save his people, only to fall to darkness. He became the Lich King, ruler of the undead Scourge.

name: Jaina Proudmoore
title: Lord Admiral of Kul Tiras
description: One of the most powerful mages alive and founder of Theramore. A voice of diplomacy turned hardened leader after tragedy, she commands frost magic of devastating strength.

name: Anduin Wrynn
title: King of Stormwind
description: The young king of Stormwind, gifted with the Holy Light. He seeks peace and unity, carrying the weight of leadership with compassion and courage.

name: Tyrande Whisperwind
title: High Priestess of Elune
description: The high priestess of the moon goddess Elune and leader of the night elves. A fierce protector of her people, blending divine power with the ferocity of the Sentinels.

name: Grommash Hellscream
title: Warchief of the Warsong Clan
description: A legendary orc warrior known for his unbreakable will. He freed the orcs from demonic corruption, sacrificing himself so his people could be truly free.
